answer.rationale: The incumbent will not meet the mandated 18% reduction and the low-cost vendor is the only quoted option that does. However, at 94% committed line volume and with only 14 days to expiry, a full unvalidated cutover could create disproportionate delivery and downstream production risk. Verify the prior low-cost-vendor record, then pursue the most tightly controlled transition feasible rather than assuming last year's onboarding experience transfers unchanged.
